_comment: HELD BY FAITH (@HeldByFaithJourney, UCh0tKIGR5Ns3Wvoai__txdg) packaging fix, 2026-08-04. NOTHING HERE HAS BEEN APPLIED. Apply by hand in Studio for now — channel-diagnosis.md has the copy-paste versions.
_not_yet_machine_readable: CORRECTION to this file's first draft: it is NOT in the shape automation/reset_packaging.py consumes, and running that script against it would fail. Three gaps: (1) reset_packaging.py hardcodes reset.json at import and has no --config flag; (2) apply_target() reads target['description'] unconditionally and raises KeyError on the title-only entries below — title-only is deliberate here, because this channel's descriptions and tags are good and must not be rewritten; (3) 'retitle' and 'unlist' are keys invented by this file, whereas the script reads 'scheduled' and 'repackage' and has no unlist path. Kept in this shape because it describes the intended change precisely; adapt the script to it rather than degrading the change to fit the script.
_expect_channel_id_when_wired: UCh0tKIGR5Ns3Wvoai__txdg — set this as expect_channel_id the moment this file becomes machine-readable, so assert_channel() refuses to write it onto Finance % Decoded, and vice versa.
_credentials: Blocked on HBF_REFRESH_TOKEN. An OAuth client ID and secret were added 2026-08-04, but those identify the application, not a channel — a refresh token is bound to the channel picked at the consent screen, and none exists for this one yet. Verified twice that day by read-only inventory runs (30915672935, 30916667377): both returned 23 owned videos, all Finance % Decoded, none from this channel. Do NOT reuse new1/new2/new3; those drive every Finance % Decoded workflow.
_series_block: The exact block that must appear in EVERY description once the renumbering below is applied. The current descriptions call the Ch. 3 video 'Episode 3' and the Ch. 4 video 'Episode 4', which contradicts their own titles. Titles and description links have to agree or the viewer cannot follow the story.

retitle._why: Series suffix only. 'Pancreatic Cancer Journey Ep. 1' -> 'Ch. 1'. The hook half of the title is strong and is NOT being touched — the Kaaba/four-days line is the best opening on the channel. Only the scheme changes, so the channel finally uses one word for one thing.
retitle.current_title: I Asked Allah for a Long Life. 4 Days Later, Cancer. | Pancreatic Cancer Journey Ep. 1
retitle.title: I Asked Allah for a Long Life. 4 Days Later, Cancer. | Ch. 1

retitle.current_title: 10 Hours in Surgery, Awake by Allah's Will | Pancreatic Cancer Journey Ep. 2
retitle.title: 10 Hours in Surgery, Awake by Allah's Will | Ch. 2

retitle._why: Drops the third series name ('Muslim Cancer Story'). Number is already correct.
retitle.current_title: Why I Felt Nothing When They Said Cancer | Muslim Cancer Story Ch. 3
retitle.title: Why I Felt Nothing When They Said Cancer | Ch. 3

retitle._why: This one is unnumbered entirely, which is why the sequence has a hole in it. It sits between Ch. 3 and the 7-day wait, so it becomes Ch. 4.
retitle.current_title: How I Told My Family I Have Cancer | Muslim Cancer Journey
retitle.title: How I Told My Family I Have Cancer | Ch. 4

retitle._why: Currently labelled Ch. 4, which collides with 9CQZ_uS3nuY once that one is numbered. Moves to Ch. 5. This is the channel's best performer (12 views, 2 likes, ~17% like rate) — the HOOK half of the title is deliberately untouched, only the suffix moves.
retitle.current_title: 7 Days Waiting for Cancer Results | Muslim Cancer Journey Ch. 4
retitle.title: 7 Days Waiting for Cancer Results | Ch. 5

unlist._why: 'The Phone Call That Ended 7 Days of Waiting' — landscape, 2:52, 1 view. Covers the same beat as the new Ch. 6 and is listed in no description, so it is an orphan splitting the story. UNLIST, never delete: it keeps the footage and the original upload date and is fully reversible. Do this only AFTER the vertical Ch. 6 is live.

channel._why: youtube_channel_about returned keywords: [] — the channel has no channel-level keywords at all. Weak signal next to per-video metadata, but it is one of the few inputs YouTube uses to place a channel in a topic cluster, and empty gives it nothing. Costs nothing, cannibalises nothing.

protected._why: Guard rail, same principle as the other channel's reset.json: never repackage a proven winner. On a channel this small 'winner' is relative, but 1TGtRIpgwt4 carries 12 of the 33 lifetime views and the only likes on the channel. Its hook, description and tags are the reference — the retitle above touches its series suffix ONLY and nothing else on it may change.

do_not_touch._why: Tags and descriptions across this channel are genuinely good — 14 to 17 specific tags per video, chaptered and well-written descriptions with a proper medical disclaimer. They are not the problem and rewriting them would burn effort while risking a real asset. Format, cadence and series numbering are the whole fix.
